note: The private half of tests/data/own_hop_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the hop of a re-order, for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the product rule that the glide and shaped-link tests hold. The engine puts an ant that walks and is given a new order (or a stop) on the middle of its tile at once, up to half a tile, as the original does; the picture draws that as the slide of ViewGlide::follow, never as a jump: only for an ant that was walking and now is not, that stands on the middle of a tile, and that moved by more than a walk of the time between two frames covers; from where the last frame drew it, with the clip's frames counted; for the ants of every player, in a game of one machine as much as in a network match; forgotten at clear(), and never across the fog.
